facts.text: All undergraduate students at Saint Louis University complete the Saint Louis University Core, an integrated intellectual experience grounded in the Catholic, Jesuit tradition.

sources.title: Saint Louis University Undergraduate Core : SLU - Saint Louis University
sources.quote: The Saint Louis University Core is an integrated intellectual experience completed by all baccalaureate students, regardless of major, program, college, school or campus.

sources.title: Saint Louis University Undergraduate Core : SLU - Saint Louis University
sources.quote: The University Core prepares all SLU students to be intellectually flexible, creative and reflective critical thinkers in the spirit of the Catholic, Jesuit tradition.
